description: Register an AI system, by the rules of POST /v1/ai/systems. Name and purpose are fixed once registered. A high-risk system with no `oversight` is accepted with a warning (AI Act Art. 14). Classifying the system is the company's call; do not choose a risk class the user has not given you: leave it unassessed.

oversight.description: Who can stop or override it, and how.

purpose.description: What the system decides or produces, in a sentence.
